limiterDetail: Main limiter: current , and only at Tara (0.8–1.3 kt over the next 24h) and Turda (0.8–1.1 kt). Everywhere else current stays at 0.7 kt or less, ECMWF wind stays under 8 kt (except a Barangonan pickup to ~10 kt around Tue 2 AM), and 24h rain is only 1.3–4.9 mm. ECMWF rates Mon 19 and Tue 20 GOOD for the day.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The morning showers and southern wind have cleared, and 14 of 16 grounds are now GOOD (this morning it was 3 GOOD, 12 MARGINAL, 1 POOR). Wind is 1.4–7.4 kt everywhere, rain is light, and only Tara (1.2 kt) and Turda (1.0 kt) are POOR, both on current.

The supply outlook is unchanged: ABOVE NORMAL today and Tuesday, softening Wednesday, BELOW NORMAL by Thu 22. The week's worst day moves back to Thu 22 (POOR, current 0.9 kt); Fri 23 is now mostly dry at 10 kt. Tue 20 stays GOOD but is a little wetter (~6 mm, up from ~2.8).
GFS now agrees with ECMWF on both wind and rain. PAGASA's General Flood Advisory #2 for MIMAROPA (5:13 AM PHT) is still the latest and runs to about 5:13 PM today; there's no gale or storm signal.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged): good arrivals Mon 19 to Wed 21 morning, but no multi-day surge. Shortage risk stays ELEVATED for the Wed 21 to Sun 25 catch, felt Thu 22 to Mon 26. Tara and Turda are BELOW NORMAL locally on current. Buying ahead today and Tuesday still makes sense.

bestWindow.headline: Now to Tue ~11 AM (14 grounds)
details: Tonight, ~10 PM to Tue 5 AM: Coron, Culion and Galoc are the calmest, with 1.5–2.5 kt wind, 0.1–0.3 kt current and only drizzle (0.2 mm/h). Linapacan is calmest this afternoon to ~8 PM (1–2.5 kt, current 0.3).

Tue ~6–10 AM: Cabunlawan, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan go slack (0.0–0.1 kt) with 4 kt wind. The model's calmest combined hour is ~Tue noon at Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot (1.2–2.2 kt, current 0.0–0.3), but Coron, Culion and Galoc get a ~1.2 mm/h shower around then.
Keep boats off Barangonan around Tue 1–3 AM (9–10 kt) and off Tara for the full 24h. Turda is easiest Tue ~6–10 AM (0.8 kt).
